gen-dafont-quantum-gf-savate: Quantum draws plain, unshaded lines with loose, generous spacing between letters. Savate, a sans with gently swelling rounded letters and open curves, would carry paragraph after paragraph with a soft, unhurried flow.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Sleek as wire, Quantum glides across the line while Schibsted Grotesk below opens its e and a wide. Together the two keep the page moving without any fuss.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-sen: Sen traces each letter in a single constant line, with curves that stop short of turning inward. Sen's unvarying line is its standout quality beside the loose, spacious Quantum.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-sintony: Quantum gives every arch and stem the same weight, with loose letterspacing. Its standout quality is smoothness: Sintony, a sans-serif, has a chunky midzone and curves that never clog.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-sofia-sans: Loose, spacious letterfit gives Quantum a display look that breathes. Sofia Sans draws every rounded letter with unmodulated strokes and an open side, so paragraphs keep a steady, modern pace.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-sono: Sono spaces its letters generously, lets its lowercase loom large against the capitals, and leaves every a with its mouth ajar. Quantum, its horizontals matching its verticals, supplies a crisp counterpoint on top.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch has open curves you can look right into, and every lowercase word feels big-bodied. Stack Sans Notch holds horizontals and verticals at identical thickness, its standout quality against the loose letterfit of Quantum.
